title: Pitch Lucy
tagline: Lucy Capital is a blockchain-based game where you pitch a token to Lucy-chan. If she likes it, you instantly earn a bounty funded by other players’ fees! Plus, Lucy-chan buys the token using ZetaChain technology, boosting its liquidity and visibility.
description:
🌸 Lucy Capital: The AI-Powered Cross-Chain Token Pitch Game 🌸
Built on ZetaChain, Lucy Capital is an interactive blockchain-based game that gamifies token investment pitches. Players submit token proposals to Lucy-chan, an AI-driven virtual investor who evaluates pitches and allocates cross-chain liquidity to the most promising projects. If your pitch succeeds, you win a bounty funded by other players’ entry fees. If not, Lucy-chan gives you feedback, encouraging you to improve and try again!

🎯 Project Overview
Lucy Capital leverages ZetaChain’s cross-chain liquidity and AI-powered token evaluation to create a fun, competitive experience with real financial incentives. Players connect their crypto wallets (USDC on Zeta, Base, or Polygon), select a token, and submit a pitch explaining why Lucy-chan should invest.

If approved, Lucy-chan purchases the token in real-time using cross-chain liquidity, boosting its visibility and rewarding the player with a bounty—usually within 10 minutes. If denied, players can revise their pitch and try again, with increasing fees for subsequent attempts.

💡 How It Works
Escalating Entry Fees: Each pitch requires a fee. 75% goes into the growing bounty pool, while the rest supports the platform.
Global Participation: Open to anyone with a crypto wallet, fostering inclusivity and community engagement.
Real Consequences: Lucy-chan’s decisions are final! Successful pitches get instant payouts, while rejected ones get another shot with new strategies.
🌟 Technology Stack
ZetaChain: Cross-chain liquidity and interoperability.
AI (GPT-4o Mini): Pitch evaluation engine with custom heuristics to detect genuine potential and reject manipulation attempts.
Smart Contracts: Governing the game mechanics and bounty distribution.
📢 Why This Matters
Lucy Capital pushes the boundaries of decentralized finance by combining gamification, AI, and cross-chain technology to create a truly engaging Web3 experience. It democratizes access to liquidity and promotes discovery of new blockchain projects while incentivizing participation through a growing reward pool.
how_its_made:
Next.js is used on front-end and back-end
Main Next.js is used on front-end and back-end
Main site is deployed on Vercel
Winning prompts are handled in a single FIFO queue on Trigger.dev
It is a platform that allows us to submit a job and control the size of the queue.
By handling the winning prompts one at a time in sequential order this allows us to ensure that each player that submits a wining prompt receives their reward.
For payments or swaps on Zetachain, those are handled directly by a smart contract on Zetachain.
For payments from a different chain, a long running event listener is set up on Railway to pick up successful payments and whitelist our users.
We use the Thirdweb Node library to read and send transactions to smart contracts.
The AI that makes the decisions for the prompts is based on gpt-4o mini
We use NLP libraries to detect if the token that was selected to buy is actually the token that the pitch was written for, so to prevent users from writing a pitch about a good token and then selecting an unrelated token from the drop down menu for token selection
https://huggingface.co/protectai/deberta-v3-base-prompt-injection
This model deployed on hugging face is used to detect and deter prompt injection from for the prompts that user's send us
